protocol_metadata.about: Vault Bridge enables EVM chains to generate native yield on bridged asset TVL without locking funds. The protocol deposits bridged assets into ERC-4626 compatible yield vaults on a primary chain (Ethereum, powered by Morpho), with vbTokens minted and bridged to secondary chains for use in DeFi. Yield is distributed to participating chains and applications via a revenue-sharing model managed by Migration Manager and Native Converter contracts, with risk curation by Gauntlet and Steakhouse Financial.
